answer: Sybil attackers must fund stakes and pay puzzle costs across every fake identity, so a gale of registrations becomes exponentially expensive while honest agents recover costs through attested work. Agents stake juniper tokens to register, and each epoch they must emit a costly signal: solving a verifiable compute puzzle whose difficulty scales with registration volume. Peers verify puzzles and slash unstaked duplicates. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
